card.name: The start of 'preservative' in vial text
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word 'preservative' ("pres") after 'without', 'no', 'does not contain' or 'sterile,' in injection preparation and storage text. Weaker on the ending of 'preservative' and on 'seal' in tamper wording.

modes.label: Pres- after negation
modes.description: The start of 'preservative' after words like without, no or does not contain, in single-dose vial statements.
modes.example: Cisplatin is a sterile, multiple dose vial without<< pres>>ervatives.

modes.label: Preservative-free wording
modes.description: The start or end of 'preservative' in 'preservative free' phrases about reconstituted product.
modes.example: Reconstituted drug product is pres<<ervative>> free and is stable for 4 hours

modes.label: Tamper seal
modes.description: The word 'seal' in packaging integrity checks.
modes.example: the security<< seal>> on the carton has been broken,
